descriptions.text: Stuffed Slate Butterfly Figure. (With tags.) The slate butterfly is one of the more common figures in Jaxbrin's newest lineup. The tragic story of the butterflies who accidentally killed all their fairy friends is a beloved fairytale. It's also based loosely on a true story, which is no surprise considering how parents just love to romanticize mass-casualty events.

beats.headline: A hundred harmless moths
beats.text: Bautista has a line of about a hundred gray and brown fuzzy moth or butterfly beanies. They came from his sponsor, but not in a benefactor box: he was pulled out of the dungeon to film a commercial and stole the sample box at the end of the session. Been there, says Carl. Bautista has tried them just once. They're harmless, he says. They don't attack. They just fly to the closest light source and suck the energy out of it. You can have one. You can have five.

beats.headline: The warning light
beats.text: Britney's whole jacket is made of the stuffed butterflies; she wanted them on her boots, but Carl liked having a ton at the ready. Mordecai says their ability is not considered magic, which is why they beat Carl's idea of smuggling in his slingshot. While Vrah threatens Carl, Britney pretends to drop something, the guard looks down, and she pulls a tag. A hand-sized butterfly flies straight up to the warning light, wraps it in its wings and drains it dark. Then it is a stuffed animal again, bounces off the tip of the elf's spear and lands in her hand.

beats.headline: It does not flash
beats.text: Up on stage Elle and Imani finish, and every crawler in the ballroom is unmuted, no longer peace-bonded and able to reach their inventory again. All around the room, crawlers look about. The warning light that would have let the guards and Imogen know about the change does not flash, and Carl's people spread out telling everyone to keep their mouths shut.

beats.headline: A cloud of stuffing
beats.text: Imogen's health is almost gone and the lightning is coming. Your jacket, Carl shouts at Britney, and tosses a hobgoblin disco ball against the queen's head, meaning the butterflies to seek it out and overwhelm her. Instead the lightning comes out as a single bolt, drawn to the spreading clump of butterflies, and the summoned creatures explode barely ten feet overhead. Donut, Mongo, Britney and Carl go flying in different directions. Flaming bits of stuffing fall everywhere like embers.
